shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure occupying most of the field
low-relief carving in coarse grey stone
incised linear detail on the body
worn, eroded surface with damaged edges
justification: Both present a single large humanoid figure carved in shallow relief on weathered grey stone, with an arm crossing the torso and a roughly circular ornament, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a freestanding, blocky three-dimensional statue with schematic frontal forms and heavy volumes, while B is a flat wall panel bearing a finely incised profile figure with dense, minutely ruled feather and drapery detail — utterly different formats and levels of graphic refinement.
